name: diverge
description: Diverge ephemeral preview environments, load testing, and root-cause diagnostics

slashCommands.name: preview
slashCommands.description: Create or manage a Diverge preview environment for the current branch
slashCommands.prompt: Inspect current git branch, check if a Diverge preview exists via diverge_get_environment, and spin one up with diverge_create_environment if needed.

slashCommands.name: doctor
slashCommands.description: Run Diverge Doctor to diagnose failing preview pods or unprogrammed routes
slashCommands.prompt: Call diverge_doctor on the active preview environment and suggest concrete code or configuration remedies.

slashCommands.name: loadtest
slashCommands.description: Run an ephemeral load test against the preview candidate and compare with baseline
slashCommands.prompt: Call diverge_loadtest with target URL and current routing key, reporting latency percentiles (p50, p95, p99).
